_comment: v18: port of the #1388 crown recipe (VE + readout calibration + batch-512 step-shape at muon_lr 0.04, wsd 0.55/0.45 1-sqrt, wd 0.05, embed_lr 0.006, beta2 0.98, warmup 600) onto the richer v7lite base (untied head, z-loss, qk-norm, unet-skip, softcap, epoch-permutation sampler). Muon momentum warmup 0.85->0.95 over warmup steps. 9200 steps x 262144 tok = 2.41B tok, measured 210K tok/s on the attested H200 => ~4.76 normalized H100h (5.0 cap).
